name: Shelly
source:
A prototype of the artificial demi-human Oni developed by the Empire.

Based on the legends of the eastern countries, she is a half-human, half-demon being created using magical beasts that live in the east and captured half-elves.

Her appearance is not much different from a human, but she has short, pointed ears, two horns on her forehead, and fang-like canines.

She also has high physical abilities, and can temporarily increase her strength and demonstrate strength enough to break a sword with her bare hands.

However, her research has only achieved a certain level of success, and if she pushes herself too hard, there is a risk that her body will be damaged or her mind will collapse.

She does not have a name, and is called [No. 306].

Originally a half-elf, she was abandoned in her childhood and was not accepted by either humans or elves, and she has a history of giving up everything, and has already forgotten her real name and the faces of her parents.

Although she was not raised in a good environment, she feels grateful to the Empire for picking her up, and swears loyalty to them.

Later, Ashley gives her the name [Sherry].
